_caps: A grant never exceeds its table's cap (no day cap since 2026-09-23 — 体力 alone limits a day).
_economy: 2026-09-24 (his: games cost a little 体力, the card fight is the best 修为 per 体力). 修为 per 体力 at 练气: haunt 25/8 = 3.1 (2.7 expected at the gate's ~85% win) · elite 38/12 = 3.2 (2.1 expected at ~65%) · a hosted game 5/3 = 1.7 · 论道 6/3 = 2.0 — every one below a fight even at the fight's odds. A normal 练气 day in 徐 — two haunts and a road beast (3 fights, ~2.5 won ≈ 64), the six games (30), story and errands (~20) — is ~115, so 练气's 810 takes about a week. Before: the games alone paid 180 for no 体力, and 练气 took about three days.
_tale: 今日传闻 (design.md § 今日传闻): Ling writes no number. Each step pays the `tale` table and the finale the `tale_end` table, both capped; the whole tale never pays more than `cap` (a fifth step eats into the finale), and pay() scales it by the roots, the day's cast and the realm like any grant. One finale `drop`: the highest-tier entry at or below the player's realm (an item, or a card not held and of a root the player has), picked by the tale's id. Economy: a step costs its board's 体力 (stamina.cost.game, 3) plus the walk; a 4-step tale with an elite finale is ~36 体力 for 40 + 25 修为 here plus the elite's own 38 — ~2.9 per 体力, just under a fight's 3.1, the walking being the difference.
_stamina: stamina is the pace — design.md § 灵气. Refills by the clock, full in refill_hours; actions cost it; a quest paid refills it (the app's own `qi`, else refill.quest).

bond._about: 羁绊 (rules.mjs § 羁绊)：和银月一起走过的事慢慢长起来。规则记，Ling 只能提议一次谈心。每天至多长 day_cap。等级到了，她那张牌站得更高（lift），疗伤回得更多（tend，占气血上限的份）。 数值由闸量过（2026-09-23）：同心 +1/+1 让会读场的多赢 6.7 点，与带剑、问斗法大吉同一量级；+2/+2 是 +12.3 点、赢到 97%，那就不是仗了。
